استقضوا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْضَوْا (istaqḍaw) /is.taq.dˤaw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# اُسْتُقْضُوا (ustuqḍū) /us.tuq.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# اِسْتَقْضُوا (istaqḍū) /is.taq.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
